name: transitions-demo
description: Each chapter transition on a sample tile: zoom through, colour flood, iris, whip and dip.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: zoom, flood, iris, whip or dip

parameters.name: tile
parameters.description: the mobject the transition takes off from (a transition_tile)

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: colour of the flood; default ACCENT

returns: the transition to pass as chapter(transition=...); transition_tile(kind) makes a labelled sample to take off from
